description: This file contains pytest fixtures for setting up environment variables, initializing a FastAPI app, and creating an asynchronous HTTP client for integration testing of the 'notes_backend' application. It is specifically designed for testing purposes, setting environment variables, and providing helper functions to facilitate testing of API endpoints.

methods.name: None _set_required_env()
methods.description: Sets required environment variables with default values if they are not already set, ensuring the application has necessary configuration for testing.

methods.name: Any app()
methods.description: Imports and returns the FastAPI application instance after ensuring environment variables are set.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[AsyncClient] client(app: Any)
methods.description: Creates and yields an asynchronous HTTP client bound to the FastAPI app for testing purposes.

methods.name: str _signup_and_get_token(ac: AsyncClient, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Helper coroutine that registers a new user via the API and retrieves a JWT access token.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] auth_headers(client: AsyncClient)
methods.description: Creates and returns authorization headers containing a bearer token for authenticated requests.

ctags.name: _signup_and_get_token
ctags.pattern: /^async def _signup_and_get_token(ac: AsyncClient, *, email: str, password: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: fastapi_app
ctags.pattern: /^    from src.api.main import app as fastapi_app  # noqa: WPS433 (import inside function)$/
